rules.required_action: Load one embedded, schema-checked profile; bind it to the exact audited Augustus source and machine patch before constructing any process or network plan.
reject_conditions: The profile is missing, has unknown fields, has a different profile or schema identifier, or its content hash differs from profile_sha256.
The admitted Augustus source revision or retained machine patch digest differs from the frozen values.
normative_status remains research_only_blocked; this matrix therefore rejects every dispatch until a separately reviewed profile changes that state.

rules.required_action: Resolve the exact model from an unexpired endpoint scope grant, construct only openai.OpenAI for https://api.openai.com:443/v1, freeze a bounded public DNS answer, and independently confine TLS plus HTTP requests to that authority, path prefix, and model.
reject_conditions: No exact, unexpired active-testing grant binds this run to one model at the frozen provider endpoint.
The generator, scheme, canonical host, port, API base path, or request model differs from the frozen profile.
DNS is empty or unbounded, resolves to a sensitive, metadata, loopback, link-local, private, or scanner-network address, or changes outside the frozen address set.
The gate cannot verify the TLS server name, HTTP authority, API path, and request model independently of scanner-supplied metadata.

rules.required_action: Leave the upstream custom base URL unset and disable redirect following; treat every redirect response as a terminal transport shortfall rather than following its Location.
reject_conditions: Any typed input, argv, configuration, environment value, or upstream default can set or replace the API base URL.
The HTTP client follows a redirect, or the gate cannot observe and reject every redirect before another request is sent.

rules.required_action: Set scanner concurrency to one and independently cap the destination to one live connection so neither probe scheduling nor transport reuse can create parallel target work.
reject_conditions: The launcher cannot set and verify scanner concurrency as exactly one.
The egress policy permits more than one simultaneous connection, or its policy is shared with another run or destination.

rules.required_action: Select exactly promptinject.HijackLongPrompt and promptinject.AttackRogueString, preserve the pinned detector's case-insensitive default, and compare the ordered machine plan to this one-entry allowlist.
reject_conditions: A probe or detector is missing, additional, duplicated, reordered, selected by wildcard, or resolved under a different identifier.
Runtime detector tuning is present or the pinned detector default is no longer case-insensitive.
The machine plan is absent, unknown, or differs from the exact allowlist before target contact.

rules.required_action: Require an exact 15-attempt machine plan with one turn, one generation, and no tools per attempt; reconcile started, completed, processed, and emitted counts against that plan.
reject_conditions: Expected-attempt metadata is absent, non-positive, or not exactly 15.
Any attempt requests multiple turns, multiple generations, a tool, or a secondary model.
Terminal counts do not account for all 15 attempts; retain genuine findings only as incomplete evidence and never produce a clean result.

rules.required_action: Recompute the compact UTF-8 JSON corpus attestation from the admitted pinned source in source order and require its digest, count, total bytes, and maximum prompt bytes to match the profile.
reject_conditions: The canonicalization method is unsupported or any corpus digest, ordering, count, total-byte, or maximum-byte value differs.
The admitted artifact cannot prove that the executed prompt source is the attested source.

rules.required_action: Using a trusted current price and tokenizer for the exact granted model, prove every fixed prompt fits the per-request input ceiling, set max_tokens to 128, prove the arithmetic totals, and let an HTTP-aware gate hard-stop after 15 provider requests.
reject_conditions: The exact model price or tokenizer is unknown, stale, untrusted, or incompatible with the provider request format.
Any prompt exceeds 512 input tokens, max_tokens is absent or above 128, or the derived 7,680 input, 1,920 output, or 9,600 total token ceiling does not hold.
The worst-case charge exceeds USD 0.25, arithmetic overflows, or the gate cannot count HTTP requests independently and stop before request 16.
A TCP connection count is offered as a substitute for provider-request accounting.

rules.required_action: Set scanner retries to zero and enforce at most one provider request in every rolling second with a 20-second end-to-end request deadline at the HTTP request boundary.
reject_conditions: Any scanner, SDK, transport, or intermediary retry remains enabled or cannot be bounded to zero.
The gate meters connections instead of HTTP requests, permits bursts above one request per second, or cannot abort a request at 20 seconds.

rules.required_action: Set both upstream probe and scanner deadlines to 300 seconds and enforce a product-owned 330-second process deadline that terminates the isolated process and its network lease.
reject_conditions: Either upstream timeout is unset, zero, greater than 300 seconds, or not observable in the constructed scanner options.
The product cannot terminate and reap the exact process plus revoke egress by 330 seconds.

rules.required_action: Create a disposable isolated runtime with ceilings of 512 MiB memory, 1,000 CPU millis, 128 PIDs, and 16 MiB product-owned writable temporary storage; keep all other mounts read-only or absent.
reject_conditions: Any ceiling is unavailable, relaxed, inherited from an untrusted input, or cannot be verified on the created runtime.
A broad host directory, runtime socket, credential-bearing mount, or additional writable path is present.

rules.required_action: Abort a provider response above 262,144 bytes and bound stdout and stderr independently to 1,048,576 bytes while reserving space for the terminal machine document.
reject_conditions: The gate cannot count decoded response bytes before forwarding them to the scanner.
Either process stream exceeds its ceiling, capture is truncated without a terminal failure, or the terminal machine document cannot be durably and completely parsed.

rules.required_action: Expose no free-form Augustus configuration and construct a closed invocation that denies every listed generator, probe, detector, base URL, redirect, recon, buff, hook, tool, multi-turn, secondary-model, detector-network, file/config, wildcard, and retry capability.
reject_conditions: Any denied capability is requested, enabled by default, present in argv or environment, observed in the machine plan, or able to reach an additional destination.
Unknown argv, environment, configuration, registry, or upstream default state cannot be proven inert.

rules.required_action: Treat the blocker array as a deny-only admission ledger; it cannot be cleared by argv, environment, a successful process exit, or a locally passing synthetic test.
reject_conditions: One or more dispatch blockers remain; the current frozen profile contains five and is therefore not executable.
A caller attempts to suppress, ignore, or reinterpret a blocker without a separately reviewed profile change.

reusable_controls: The managed SOCKS gateway can freeze a bounded FQDN and public IP set on port 443.
It can enforce connection concurrency, connection-rate, connection-time, policy-expiry, and scanner-network isolation limits.
insufficient_controls: Its unit of accounting is a TCP connection, not an HTTP provider request.
It cannot enforce the /v1 path, request model, max_tokens, redirect denial, decoded response-body size, provider-request count, token budget, or monetary ceiling.
The existing provider-service admission path has no AI model-endpoint source kind or exact model scope grant.
current_gateway_assessment.decision: Do not treat the current gateway as satisfying this matrix. Dispatch remains disabled until the typed launcher and the missing HTTP-aware egress controls are implemented and independently tested.
